The '''Arena of the Mind''' was a huge amphitheater located outside of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ropagis]] on the continent [[Forethought]] on the planet [[Ropagi II]]. It had excellent acoustics, translation facilities and seats for around 10,000 beings. [[Ropagu]] intellectuals came here to face off against each other in philosophical debates, but guest speakers from off-world were invited as well. For the peace-minded Ropagu, the arena was a sacred site and never placed any guards there.<ref name="TSK">[[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']]</ref>
